Vulkan resource-query ABI declarations

Copyright (c) 2015-2019 The Khronos Group Inc.

The private driver declarations in src/AiResources.cpp adapt a small subset of
Vulkan-Headers v1.1.130, include/vulkan/vulkan_core.h:
https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers/blob/v1.1.130/include/vulkan/vulkan_core.h

Modifications: private names, grouped scalar declarations, dynamic function
lookup and x64 ABI assertions. The Vulkan SDK and loader are not bundled;
resource queries use the existing system driver and safely fall back when absent.
